focus.title: Complete the for_each module call
focus.todo: Instantiate the module once per environment with for_each.

hints.why: Modules package a group of resources behind a small input/output contract. They turn copy-pasted infrastructure into something a team can version, review and reuse.
hints.what: Complete the marked TODO in `main.tf`. Instantiate the module once per environment with for_each. Use the visible constraints as your checklist before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use a module when the same group of resources appears more than once, when a team needs a supported interface, or when you want to test a component independently.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work inside the single TODO region. Change one requirement at a time: add the named block, argument or reference, then run the tests. When a check fails, match its wording to the constraints and fix only the block it names.
